turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! I hope you're having a good Monday. How are you feeling today? Are you fully back to 100% after recovering from that flu?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Yes, I'm feeling completely back to my usual self, thankfully. I'm actually just waking up and starting my day with some chilled, slow-steeped coffee concentrate over ice to get me moving. It's still so hot here in Phoenix, so it's perfect.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds incredibly refreshing, and I'm so glad to hear you're feeling healthy again. Are you preparing for another busy night shift at the ER?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I am! I just put together a quick lunch to eat before I have to head out. I made a turkey and swiss sandwich on two slices of my own naturally leavened wild yeast bread.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Your sourdough baking always sounds amazing! There's nothing like a homemade sandwich. How are you planning to get to the hospital this evening?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! It really hit the spot. For my commute tonight, I'm riding the late-night city transit bus.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Taking the bus is a nice way to let someone else handle the traffic. Do you usually listen to something to pass the time on the ride?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Absolutely. I've got a hilarious audio show queued up where a couple of stand-up comics joke about current events.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A good laugh is the perfect way to prep for a high-energy shift! Speaking of fun, have you and Tom managed to get any salsa dancing in lately, or has work been keeping you too busy?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We haven't danced in a little while because of our schedules, but we're hoping to find some time for salsa later this week. Right now, I'm just focusing on getting ready for tonight.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That makes sense. I hope you and Tom get to dance soon, and I hope tonight's shift goes smoothly for you!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks so much! I appreciate it. I'll talk to you tomorrow!
